title: Do You Get Extra Pay for Working Sundays? 💶 #shorts
description:
Extra pay for Sundays by law in Germany? Guess: yes or no.

There is no legal right to a Sunday bonus in Germany; you only get one if your contract or a pay agreement says so. But if your boss pays one, up to 50 % of your base pay is tax-free on Sundays (§3b EStG), and free of social contributions if your base pay is up to 25 €/h. Example: minimum wage 13.90 € x 8 h = 111.20 €, a 50 % bonus adds 55.60 €. Public holidays up to 125 %, 1 May 150 %.

Sources: gesetze-im-internet.de (§3b EStG), Deutsche Rentenversicherung, karrierebibel.de

Not financial advice.
